The '''242X''' was a model of [[Augmented spin barrel/Legends|augmented spin barrel]] available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Produced by [[Dolmax/Legends|Dolmax]], the attachment could only be used with [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] or [[Heavy blaster rifle/Legends|heavy blaster rifles]] and was sold for 1750 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The barrel gave greater damage output and [[Armor/Legends|armor]] penetration but meant the barrel and frame of the weapon were under more stress.<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook" />
